1 A NAKED MAN 1

sits discreetly upon a raised platform -- still as a statue.

INT. ART STUDIO - NIGHT
The scratching comes from the TWENTY students sketching before
their easels. A legend appears: GEORGE WASHINGTON UNIVERSITY
EXTENSION PROGRAM. WASHINGTON, D.C.
CAMERA DRIFTS among the students, men and women ranging from
eighteen to seventy-five. All concentrating intensely on their
work... FINDING one man who appears to be working even more
intensely than the others. His name is JOHN MOSTOW. Bearded,
his long hair dirty and uncombed, Mostow has chosen a position
in the back of the studio, behind the other students, in the
dimmest light.
CLOSE ON MOSTOW
He works feverishly -- almost desperately -- a charcoal stub

r pinched in his blackened fingers. Perspiration beads on his
brow.
MATCHING CLOSE ON MODEL'S FACE
The bones of his cheek and brow prominent in this light. His
eyes vacant, downcast and expressionless.
MATCHING TO MOSTOW
whose eyes dart between his work and his subject. We can hear
his breathing, shallow and quick as he sketches.
MATCHING TO MOSTOW'S SKETCH PAD
Where his fingers, dirty black with charcoal, pinch a short
thick pencil, drawing not the fine features of the model, but
the horrible eyes of a monster. A beast -- its gnashing teeth
and hideous expression at once frightening and beautiful.
RESUME MOSTOW
Using a CARPET KNIFE (also known as a MATTE KNIFE) to sharpen
his stubby charcoal pencil. His hands shaky, hurried as he
curls off thin shavings of wood which drop to the floor. And
CUTTING his finger as he does -- blood immediately springing

— from the wound. ,
